title: Ijāza for the K. al-Maṣābīḥ

date.basis: MK gives no date on the page read; the ijāza is in MS Majlis 10196 (copied 828-38/1425-35), so it was written before ca. 838/1435

addressee: one of his prominent contemporaries (not named on the page read)
occasion: a certificate for the K. al-Maṣābīḥ, given by Ibn Turka to a contemporary
summary: The only ijāza MK lists; it is a certificate for the K. al-Maṣābīḥ (Arabic), given by Ibn Turka to a prominent contemporary; MK gives no recipient or date on the page read.
